description: Add a supplier to the directory and return its SUP-YYYY-NNNN number: the name, what they supply, who to contact and how, the payment terms, the lead time in days, and notes. Free tier: 10 suppliers; removing one you no longer use frees its slot.

category.description: What they supply, e.g. Packaging, Raw materials, Print. Free-form; supplier_list filters on it

contact_name.description: Your person there, e.g. Maria Chen

lead_time_days.description: Typical days from order to delivery, e.g. 14

name.description: Who you buy from, e.g. Shenzhen Box Co, or Acme Fasteners

notes.description: Anything worth remembering: minimum orders, who to escalate to, why you dropped them last time

payment_terms.description: The terms you buy on, e.g. Net 30, 50% upfront, Due on receipt

phone.description: Phone number as you would dial it

name: supplier_add
title: Add a supplier
